description: Compute international age (만 나이, the legal standard in Korea since June 2023) and year age (연 나이, used by the Youth Protection Act and military service) on a reference date. Input a birth date, or the first 7 digits of a resident registration number (YYMMDD-G) to also get sex and century. Feb 29 birthdays turn a year older on Mar 1 in common years. The input is not stored.

on.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for today in Korea (KST).

name: kr_age
title: Korean age (만 나이)
